::: {.callout-note title="Static retrieval prototype"}
This page is the bridge between the memoir analysis site and the future AI chatbot. It does **not** call an external AI model yet. Instead, it searches the citation-ready passage index and returns relevant memoir passages with chapter and passage citations.
:::

```{=html}
<div class="uvbot-page" id="uvbot-page">
  <section class="uvbot-search-card" aria-labelledby="uvbot-title">
    <h2 id="uvbot-title">Ask about the memoir</h2>
    <p class="uvbot-help">
      Type a person, place, date, chapter topic, or question. You can also use the topic buttons below:
      each topic opens suggested searches under the buttons. Click a suggestion to load it into the search box,
      edit it if needed, then press <strong>Ask / search passages</strong>.
    </p>

    <label class="uvbot-label" for="uvbot-question">Question or search terms</label>
    <input
      id="uvbot-question"
      class="uvbot-input"
      type="search"
      autocomplete="off"
      placeholder="Example: Central Intelligence Agency"
    />

    <div class="uvbot-actions" aria-label="Search actions">
      <button type="button" id="uvbot-search" class="uvbot-primary">Ask / search passages</button>
      <button type="button" id="uvbot-clear" class="uvbot-secondary">Clear</button>
    </div>

    <p class="uvbot-topic-instructions">Choose a topic to show editable search suggestions:</p>
    <div class="uvbot-topic-row" id="uvbot-topic-row" aria-label="Topic buttons">
      <button type="button" class="uvbot-topic-button" data-topic="cia">CIA / Cold War</button>
      <button type="button" class="uvbot-topic-button" data-topic="family">Family</button>
      <button type="button" class="uvbot-topic-button" data-topic="places">Places</button>
      <button type="button" class="uvbot-topic-button" data-topic="wwii">World War II</button>
      <button type="button" class="uvbot-topic-button" data-topic="south-america">South America posts</button>
      <button type="button" class="uvbot-topic-button" data-topic="college">College years</button>
    </div>

    <div id="uvbot-suggestions" class="uvbot-suggestions" hidden></div>
  </section>

  <section class="uvbot-results-section" aria-labelledby="uvbot-results-title">
    <h2 id="uvbot-results-title">Retrieved passages</h2>
    <p class="uvbot-help">Showing the strongest citation-ready matches from the passage index.</p>

    <div id="uvbot-result-status" class="uvbot-status-grid" aria-live="polite">
      <div class="uvbot-stat-card"><span class="uvbot-stat-label">Search</span><strong class="uvbot-stat-value">None yet</strong></div>
      <div class="uvbot-stat-card"><span class="uvbot-stat-label">Matches</span><strong class="uvbot-stat-value">0</strong></div>
      <div class="uvbot-stat-card"><span class="uvbot-stat-label">Index</span><strong class="uvbot-stat-value">Loading passage index...</strong></div>
      <div class="uvbot-stat-card"><span class="uvbot-stat-label">Reminder</span><strong class="uvbot-stat-value">Suggestions are editable before search.</strong></div>
    </div>

    <div id="uvbot-results" class="uvbot-results-grid"></div>
  </section>

  <section class="uvbot-instructions">
    <h2>How to read this page</h2>
    <p>
      This is a <strong>retrieval layer</strong>, not a full chatbot. The current page finds likely passages and gives
      citation-ready references. The next backend version will use the same passage index to generate narrative answers
      with citations.
    </p>
  </section>
</div>
<script src="assets/js/static_citation_bot.js"></script>
```
